Name: Grace's Farm Clothing Collection
Author: svnshxne
Description:
✦ For JA/FS: A collection of 4 overalls in purple, blue denim, black and sea green colors! Each comes with a matching skirt and pants. 4 new hats are also included; a sea green headband, a purple headband, a pastel flower crown and a morning glory flower to put in your farmer’s hair.

✦For FS - Dyeable: I created dyeable versions of every item, plus an extra flower crown with darker leaves. 

✦ To spawn JA items, you can use the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url] mod by Pathoschild.
